status: written after reading the complete v6.3 run and before the additional Argoverse 2 logs, the ground-contact label of any Argoverse 2 vehicle or any of the synthesis tables below existed. Nothing in it is a registered test; every item is exploratory and no registered verdict depends on it. The model outputs for the 16 Argoverse 2 logs of v6.3 existed and had been read, but never split by ground contact.

exploratory_analyses.more Argoverse 2 logs (3.11b): 48 further validation logs, taken in the same fixed random order after the logs the v6.3 stage tried, with every v6.3 rule unchanged; the two stages are pooled (64 logs) in every Argoverse 2 analysis.
exploratory_analyses.ground contact of real vehicles (3.11b,: the four wheel contact points of every labelled Argoverse 2 vehicle as for Virtual KITTI 2 (0.10 m above the box bottom at +-0.35 length, +-0.40 width); without instance masks a point counts as visible if it lies in the image, the vehicle's own body does not hide it (the camera lies beyond the side or end face next to that wheel, and the line of sight does not cross the vehicle's own box more than 0.3 m above its bottom, as a bumper overhanging the wheel would), no other labelled object's box (shrunk by 10 cm) crosses the line of sight at least 0.3 m in front of it, and no static LiDAR return in the window of columns u +- 2, rows v - 8 ... v is nearer than it by more than max(10%, 1 m). Labels, sample, contrast and matching as for Virtual KITTI 2; the image size used for matching is the projected box area times (1 - the vehicle's LiDAR occlusion). Expected direction: g higher when the contact is hidden (as H6). Check of the rule: the same rule, with the exact depth of static pixels in place of the LiDAR, is applied to the Virtual KITTI 2 vehicles and compared with their instance-mask labels (D37); agreement and Cohen's kappa are reported (T15d), with no threshold.
exploratory_analyses.support across testbeds (6.9): a descriptive synthesis of results that already exist, with no new test: the geometry share by ground support in every testbed (CONVOY-3D cars and crates against floating crates; CONVOY-REAL, whose inserted movers are all floating crates by design; the E5 and E5-REAL conditions; Virtual KITTI 2 and Argoverse 2 vehicles by contact), and the contrast of unsupported or hidden-contact objects against grounded ones in each testbed. Only the CONVOY-3D contrast (floating crates minus cars and crates, unpaired, cluster bootstrap over scenes) is new; the others are those of H5, H6, H11a and 6.8b.
exploratory_analyses.implied depth error (6.9): for each slope beta, exp(beta x) at s = 0.85 (x = -log 0.15): the depth overestimate the slope implies for an object keeping pace with the camera, with the interval mapped through the same function.

why: In the v6.3 run the geometry share on CONVOY-REAL was higher than on CONVOY-3D and, for four of the six models, close to that of the CONVOY-3D floating crates; CONVOY-REAL inserts only floating crates, and the pooled CONVOY-3D slope mixes grounded and floating movers. Reporting every testbed by support was decided after seeing this pattern, which is why the synthesis is descriptive and adds no verdict.
